{{Top|leg}}
[[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]], claimed to be a member of the '''Mos Eisley Merchant's Association''' in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Kabe would disguise herself as a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] and inform incoming [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] that they were required to buy a "trade license" from her for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in order to be allowed to conduct business on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
